notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.13.4.6(b)(5) requires a corresponding HLA_CALLBACK_RESPONSE for each HLA_CALLBACK_REQUEST and requires the callback-request sequence number in that response. Table 46 defines the four-byte big-endian In response to field at payload bytes 24–27, followed by the encoded service response. The public C++ object-discovery TCK observes every type-22 request in its exercised scenario and pairs it one-for-one with a type-23 response on the same connection and session using that field; it also checks the successful CallbackSucceeded protobuf value. This is bounded evidence for the exercised discovery callback path, not every possible callback family, callback-failure encoding, independent-provider interoperability, or complete conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: The public object-discovery TCK case invokes FederateAmbassador::discoverObjectInstance; a transparent loopback observer verifies that each observed HLA_CALLBACK_REQUEST receives one HLA_CALLBACK_RESPONSE whose Table 46 In response to field equals the request sequence number
